# English–Persian Dictionary v3.1 (full text)

Canonical site: https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/
Repository: https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary
Version: 3.1.0 (published 2026-11-14). Licence: MIT. Languages: English headwords, Persian (Farsi) definitions.

## What it is
A free, offline English-to-Persian bilingual dictionary for e-readers with 164,524 entries and 31,189 indexed inflected forms. It is a revision and expansion of English-Persian Dictionary v2.4 (compiled by H. Yazdani, published as a Kindle dictionary by hossein1376 at https://github.com/hossein1376/English-Persian-Kindle-Custom-Dictionary, MIT licence). According to that project, the original word list comes from the freely available MHM Advance English-Persian Dictionary; the licence terms of that older source are not known to this project.

Alternative names people use: English-Farsi dictionary, English to Persian Kindle dictionary, دیکشنری انگلیسی به فارسی, لغت نامه / واژه نامه انگلیسی به فارسی کیندل.

## Formats and where each goes
| Device or app | File (under dist/ in the repo) | Install |
|---|---|---|
| Kindle | kindle/English-Persian.Dictionary.v3.1-classic.mobi | Copy to documents/dictionaries/ on the Kindle. In a book, long-press a word, tap the dictionary name, choose "English-Persian Dictionary v3.1"; or Settings > Language & Dictionaries > Dictionaries > English |
| Kindle (apps or firmware that handle right-to-left text; or if classic shows reversed sentences) | kindle/English-Persian.Dictionary.v3.1-rtl.mobi | Same |
| Kobo (firmware 4.24+) | kobo/dicthtml-en-fa.zip | Copy to .kobo/custom-dict/ (create if missing), eject, choose under Settings > Language and dictionaries |
| KOReader (Kindle, Kobo, PocketBook, Onyx Boox, reMarkable, Android), Onyx Boox, GoldenDict, AlReader, Moon+ Reader | stardict/English-Persian-v3.1-stardict.zip | Unzip into koreader/data/dict/ or the app's dictionary folder (Boox: dicts/) |
| Readers that show HTML tags as text (CoolReader, early PocketBook/Onyx firmware) | stardict/English-Persian-v3.1-stardict-plaintext.zip | Same |
| Your own tools | data/English-Persian.v3.1.tsv | Tab-separated: headword, definition, sections, status, alternate forms |

### Why two Kindle builds
Kindle dictionary pop-ups on E Ink devices lay text out left to right and do not reorder right-to-left scripts. Following v2.4, the classic build stores each Persian definition with its words in reverse (visual) order so that it displays correctly. The right-to-left build stores natural reading order in right-to-left paragraphs. The StarDict, Kobo and TSV files use natural reading order. Try classic first on E Ink Kindles.

## What is new in v3.1
- 10,085 new entries and 3,589 subject senses added to existing words (appended after the current definition; no v3.0 definition was removed or reworded).
- Twelve sections were added in v3.1: Philosophy & logic 1,181, Arts 865, Earth & environmental sciences 753, Transport & logistics 719, Agriculture & veterinary 706, History & archaeology 542, Sociology & anthropology 525, Literature 520, Fashion & textiles 497, Education 485, Statistics 393, Media & communication 376.
- Deeper coverage in Informal & slang (1,045 to 2,456), Mathematics, Physics, Astronomy, Psychology, Linguistics, Music, Architecture, Civil engineering and Sports, and about 1,800 everyday compounds, idioms, phrasal verbs and proverbs (with the matching Persian proverb where one exists).
- Each subject glossary was written by an AI language model to pipeline/guidelines/SPEC.md and then reviewed line by line in a separate AI pass.

## What changed from v2.4
- Entries: 145,075 to 154,439 (v3.0) to 164,524 (v3.1).
- 21,578 new entries in all. v3.0 added 11,493: modern vocabulary (internet, smartphone, podcast, lockdown), science, medicine, business, everyday phrasal verbs, idioms, slang, US/UK pairs, irregular forms.
- 7,016 high-frequency definitions rewritten: most common sense first, senses grouped by part of speech, wrong equivalents removed.
- 5,346 existing entries improved or extended; 2,224 modern senses (v3.0) and 3,589 subject senses (v3.1) added and 535 very short definitions replaced along the way.
- Persian orthography normalised in 106,983 entries: Persian ی and ک instead of Arabic ي and ك, restored آ, half-spaces (می‌, ‌ها, ‌ترین), tanvin, ezafe marks, quotation marks.
- 3,120 misspelled headwords corrected (4,081 fixes), e.g. illustrous to illustrious.
- 2,128 duplicate entries merged; 97 garbled headwords cleaned; 85 cross-references resolved; corrupted numbers fixed.
- 31,189 inflected forms indexed, so looking up "walked" opens "walk".
- 25,882 entries unchanged.

### Entries by subject section (v2.4 to v3.1)
General 103,231 to 101,466; Engineering 6,909 to 7,110; Computing 3,632 to 5,399; Business & economics 3,161 to 4,335; Sports 3,550 to 4,153; Chemistry 3,688 to 4,010; Law 3,713 to 4,003; Informal & slang 79 to 2,456; Medicine 654 to 1,633; Geography 15 to 1,210; Biology 517 to 996; Mathematics 136 to 716; Psychology 13 to 676; Astronomy 460 to 670; Linguistics 63 to 665; Music 208 to 631; Physics 28 to 514. Sections new in v3.0: Politics 584, Food 537, Abbreviations 275, Religion 165. Twelve sections were added in v3.1: Philosophy & logic 1,181, Arts 865, Earth & environmental sciences 753, Transport & logistics 719, Agriculture & veterinary 706, History & archaeology 542, Sociology & anthropology 525, Literature 520, Fashion & textiles 497, Education 485, Statistics 393, Media & communication 376. An entry with senses in several sections counts in each.

## Entry format
[n.], [v.], [adj.] mark part of speech; [رایانه] (computing), [پزشکی] (medicine), [حقوق] (law) etc. mark a subject section. The marker "▪" separates sense groups (plain-text builds use "|"), the Persian comma "،" separates equivalents and the Persian semicolon "؛" separates distinct senses. "(= colour)" is a cross-reference; "(گذشتهٔ go)" and "(جمعِ child)" mark irregular forms.

## Known limits
- Not verified screen by screen on every e-reader generation. The Kindle .mobi files were compiled with Amazon's kindlegen and read back to confirm all 164,524 headwords; StarDict and Kobo look-ups were resolved programmatically.
- The right-to-left Kindle build has not been tested on a physical device.
- The 7,016 rewrites and 21,578 new entries were written by AI language models following written guidelines (pipeline/guidelines/SPEC.md and REVIEW.md) and have not been reviewed by a human Persian editor. A few new terms with no settled Persian equivalent (for example "mansplaining") have descriptive glosses.
- About 107,000 specialised entries received mechanical repairs only (word order, letters, half-spaces, numbers) and keep their 1990s wording, including run-together words such as دورازمحور.
- Headword typo correction covered words within one edit of a known English word.
- No PocketBook-native .dic build; use KOReader with the StarDict files.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Is it free? A: Yes, MIT licence, like the upstream project.
Q: Does it work offline? A: Yes, all look-ups happen on the device.
Q: How do I install it on a Kindle? A: Copy the classic .mobi into documents/dictionaries/, eject, then pick it in the dictionary pop-up or under Settings > Language & Dictionaries.
Q: Which file for Kobo? A: dicthtml-en-fa.zip into .kobo/custom-dict/ (firmware 4.24+).
Q: Which file for KOReader, Boox, GoldenDict? A: The StarDict zip.
Q: Can I rebuild it? A: Yes. pipeline/README.md in the repository explains how to regenerate the master data and the Kindle sources from the original v2.4 file; the regenerated master data and Kindle sources match the shipped files byte for byte.
Q: How can I report a wrong translation? A: Open an issue at https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/issues with the headword, the current definition and a suggested one.

## How to cite
shahabahreini. English–Persian Dictionary v3.1 (2026). https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary . Based on English-Persian Kindle Custom Dictionary by hossein1376 (https://github.com/hossein1376/English-Persian-Kindle-Custom-Dictionary). A CITATION.cff file is in the repository.

## خلاصه به فارسی
دیکشنری رایگان و آفلاین انگلیسی به فارسی با ۱۶۴٬۵۲۴ مدخل برای کیندل، کوبو، KOReader و برنامه‌های StarDict؛ بازنگری و گسترش نسخهٔ ۲٫۴ (ح. یزدانی، منتشرشده توسط hossein1376) با مجوز MIT. ۲۱٬۵۷۸ مدخل تازه (۱۰٬۰۸۵ مدخل در نسخهٔ ۳٫۱ با دوازده بخش تازه از جمله فلسفه، هنر، ادبیات، تاریخ، علوم زمین، کشاورزی و رسانه)، بازنویسی ۷٬۰۱۶ واژهٔ پرکاربرد، یکدست‌سازی املای فارسی و ثبت ۳۱٬۱۸۹ شکل صرفی. معنی‌های تازه و بازنویسی‌شده را مدل‌های هوش مصنوعی نوشته‌اند و ویراستار انسانی بررسی نکرده است. صفحهٔ فارسی: https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/fa/
